title: Five factual answers gain exact period, authority and source-access boundaries
summary: The NNSA, Hanford, Amtrak, critical-minerals and battery answers now identify their exact source entries, observation periods and remaining evidence limits. Original gate receipts, article identities and independent-review holds are preserved.
evidence_note: Twelve named sources were inspected within their located scope. Hanford PDF visual checks cover AR-41694 physical pages 1, 23–24 and AR-41695 physical pages 1, 16–17; ESCRI-SA report 4 covers pages 1, 14–15 and 35. Amtrak remains a text-only recheck: direct downloads failed with HTTP 403 and usable page images were not obtained. The ESCRI report hash matches the retained September 15 capture; no issuer correction, new extraction or independent reproduction is claimed.
publication_effect: Local draft wording and source notes only; independent review, measurement admission and release remain held. No evidence-cycle decision or future-date appointment is replaced.
